event_name: BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 03 - 05 March 2023 The Stewards From The Stewards To The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
fact: Failure to properly serve a penalty during a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article 54.4 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 31 came into the pit lane and stopped to serve a 5 second time penalty. After 4.6 seconds a mechanic started working on the car. This is a breach of the regulations, however not significant enough to warrant disqualification.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 31 Failure To Serve A Penalty
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
